verdict.rationale: A state business-filing agency could plausibly document a path for non-resident founders, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack addresses non-resident eligibility, acceptable foreign credentials or identifiers, or extra steps for foreign filers. The pages cited cover the bizfile portal, filing options, fees, and User Access only.

support.subject: As a foreign founder, the service documents a path for a non-resident to complete this task — eligibility, acceptable foreign credentials or identifiers, and any extra steps stated on its own pages
